title: Oregon Democrats propose three-year moratorium on large data centers
summary: State lawmakers proposed pausing new large data centers in Oregon for three years; Salem's council had voted July 27 to develop its own moratorium policy.

title: Anthropic signs $10B Volta cloud deal and builds in-house chip team
summary: Anthropic signed a roughly $10 billion compute deal with Volta, bringing recent compute commitments to about $71B, and confirmed a custom chip design team.
reason: More compute concentration at a frontier lab.
